'''Murkhana Space Traffic Control''', also known as '''STC''', was the agency responsible for monitoring [[Realspace/Legends|space]] flight to and from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
